When a common term is obtained as a substitute, the likest of its significates to that in the place of which it comes, is the actual substitute.

Terms:

A substitute (आदेश) is like the former occupant (स्थानी) but not in the case of a rule the occasion for the operation of which is furnished by the letters of the original term.

Terms:
The affix सिच् before आत्मनेपद affixes is कित् after स्था 'to stand' and घु मृषस्तितिक्षायाम्

verbs, and these verbs change their आ into इ before these terminations.

Terms: कित्

The affixes क and क्विप् come after the verb स्था when in composition with a word ending in a case-affix or an उपसर्ग ।

Terms: क andक्विप्

After the roots 1. स्था 'to stand' 2. गा 'to sing' 3. पा 'to drink' 4. पच् 'to cook', the affix क्तिन् is used when a word in the feminine gender denoting a 'mere action' is to be expressed.

Terms: क्तिन्
The affix अञ् already ordained -- प्राग्दीव्यतोऽण्

, comes after the word स्थण्डिल being in the Locative -7th case in construction in the sense of 'a sleeper thereon' and the whole word so formed denotes 'a person performing a vow'.

Terms: अञ्

There is लुक् elision of the affix denoting 'born therin' after a word ending in स्थान and after the words 1. गोशाल and 2. खरशाल।

Terms: लुक्

The affixes छ (ईयं) and यत् (यं) comes in the sense of 'deserving that' after the word स्थालीबिल।

Terms: छ

The affix छ (ईय) is optionally added to a stem ending in स्थान if it is compounded with something with which another is made to take an equal place.

Terms: छ (ईय)
In स्था etc. up to सित् exclusive -- उपसर्गात्‌ सुनोतिसुवतिस्यतिस्तौतिस्तोभतिस्थासेनय सेधसिचसञ्जस्वञ्जाम्

, this substitution of ष् takes place then also, when the reduplicate intervenes and the स of the reduplicate is also changed to ष।

Terms: षत्व change
